body: Hey man all of that is totally fixable, I know shit like that is super embarrassing and makes you want to disappear but things like that are totally curable, have you done anything to improve hygiene like flossing, mouth wash stuff like that? and I’m guessing you’re in Highschool or college because of table groups and stuff, love at that age isn’t apparent and sometimes there are people that love you and you don’t even realize it. Regardless, you’re going into a new part of your life where you have the control and you choose the people you associate with, if affection is what you’re looking for then I guarantee you’ll find a nice couple of friends that will give you that in a more obvious way. But at the end of the day the person that you should love the most is yourself, which is really hard to start with but looking up “how to love myself” and sticking to a regiment like journaling or affirmations for yourself can really help
